20200908_124044.jpg.alt_text: Fog hangs over a pale sandstone cliff dropping into a green-grey cove, with white surf curling onto a small beach and sea stacks offshore. Dry golden grass fills the foreground bluff. The Los Osos area coast.

20200908_135929.jpg.alt_text: Pale sandstone cliffs frame a foggy cove where green-grey surf swirls around jagged sea stacks. A lone figure stands on the distant clifftop, nearly lost in the mist. Montaña de Oro State Park, CA.

20201002_165755.jpg.alt_text: Sailboats moored on a glassy lake, masts and rows of clouds mirrored in the still water, with a tree-lined far shore. A sandy beach and a covered boat sit in the foreground — Bde Maka Ska in Minneapolis.

20201212_065856.jpg.alt_text: An infinity pool mirrors a cloud-streaked sunrise sky, its still surface reflecting palms and umbrellas. The sun sits low on the ocean horizon in gold and orange, with turquoise loungers under white umbrellas beside the pool. Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur.

IMG_6822.jpg.alt_text: A large cracked spherical boulder sits in a shallow pool of water on wet sand, waves breaking behind it under a bright blue sky with tall white clouds. Reminiscent of the Moeraki Boulders. South Island, New Zealand.
